name: Rotating Volumetric Display
aliases: Rotating Volumetric Display — Helical slicing display
definition: A larger volumetric display variant using a rotating screen (resembling a drill bit with ramps and drop-offs) and projectors positioned above, allowing for higher frame rates and larger projections.
summary: A Rotating Volumetric Display renders 3D images by sweeping a helical screen through space to achieve higher frame rates than linear reciprocating displays, though it creates a central dead spot.
